reports.performance: Plays well; a few lag spikes early on, likely shaders being compiled for the first time.
reports.notes: Changing the resolution or window mode no longer freezes the window.

links.title: Windowed resolution change leaves an empty window

issues: Changing the resolution while the game runs in a window can leave the window black while the sound loops (mtld3d's submit thread crashes).
reports.notes: Reproduced on a Retina display in Video options: borderless window at native resolution, then "Run in a window", then a lower resolution. The window goes black and the sound loops.
reports.followUp: Fixed upstream in mtld3d 0.15; it reaches Hadron with an mtld3d update.

links.title: Windowed resolution change leaves an empty window

reports.notes: Steam launch and focus regression checks passed in two owner-led runs.

issues: With an external display, the game opens on the main (menu-bar) display, and moving a running game between displays is unreliable.
reports.notes: Plays fully from Mac Steam through Hadron.
